name: Wand of Enemy Detection
description: A wand of dark wood that twitches in the hand like a dowsing rod.
body:
## What it does

Spend a charge as an action and for a minute you know the direction of the nearest creature hostile to you within 60 feet, whatever hides it.

## Charges

It holds seven and regains 1d6 + 1 each dawn. Spend the last and it may crumble to ash.

features.name: Enemy Detection
features.text: 1 charge: for a minute you know the direction of the nearest hostile creature within 60 feet, ethereal, invisible, disguised or hidden.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles to ash
